gift_funds_used.derivation_rule: gift letter present in file <=> gift funds used (fixture-set invariant; extraction contract should eventually deliver gift_funds_used directly - 002e/002g interface note)

loan_program.derivation_rule: presence of a program-specific citable field (fha_case_number_1003) unambiguously identifies the loan program -- program_gating.py's own _PREFIX_TO_PROGRAM token set, reused verbatim (010a)

loan_transaction_type.derivation_rule: 1003's own loan-purpose text maps literally to the fact vocabulary's canonical token (storage/fact_vocabulary/v6.json question_bindings) -- conservative mapping, never inferring cash-out status beyond what the document states

occupancy_type.derivation_rule: 1003's own occupancy question text maps literally to the fact vocabulary's canonical token (storage/fact_vocabulary/v7.json question_bindings) -- conservative mapping, never inferring occupancy beyond what the document states

appraisal_in_file.reason: no positive appraisal signal found (checked ('doc_present_va_appraisal', 'doc_present_usda_appraisal') and appraised_value); absence in a narrow, defect-targeted fixture does not mean no appraisal exists in the real file

income_type_used_for_qualification.reason: neither a self-employment marker (years_self_employed_1003) nor a VOE-sourced field (voe_employer_name) is present in loan.fields -- refusing to guess whether qualifying income is W-2 or self-employed
